title: The Great Gear Train
speaker: kenji
intro: Now — the Great Gear Train! We need the output to spin FAST: at least three turns for every crank. Big gear driving small gear means speed. Feel the maths, Max-kun!
success: Listen to it sing! A big driver spinning a small output — that's how three-times speed feels.
goalText: Make the output spin at least 3 turns per crank: driver teeth ÷ output teeth ≥ 3.
failText: Count the teeth! A 24-tooth driver turning an 8-tooth output spins it 24 ÷ 8 = 3 times.
